comment: Seed to Shelf teaser: short open → field → packhouse → dispatch → close, with burned-in captions. Same scene modules as vo_script.impact.json (the open's x5 is dropped). Build with CUT=impact-teaser.

lines.text: A seedling that never comes up.
A harvest that misses the order.
A crate at the wrong store.
Impact isn't a promise. It's a result.
lines.tts: Impact isn't a promise... It's a result.

lines.text: Here are three, from one grower's season.
In the field, a camera on the tractor measures every lettuce.
The model forecasts the boxes ready each day, and matches them to the orders.
So the harvest is cut to the order: less lettuce thrown away, and every delivery arrives complete.
In the packhouse, every pumpkin is counted and graded for quality, with no hand counts.
Every pumpkin sells in the class it earned, and the team stops counting, and starts running the line.
At dispatch, one crate at the wrong supermarket means a rejection, and a fine.
AI recognizes each crate, checks the order, labels it, and holds back any mismatch.
The right crate reaches the right store, the first time. No fines, no returns, no product lost. Every rejection avoided keeps around fifteen hundred dollars in the business.
Six problems. Six results. One season.
lines.tts: Six problems... Six results... One season.

lines.text: Less waste, better prices, and faster decisions. That's how AI makes a whole industry more productive.
